The new template renders every assistant history turn as `<think></think>` plus the answer, the form the previous one used once a newer user turn followed; the TFLite, tokenizer and executor-metadata sections are byte-identical to the previous file, the container header is 1.7.0 (written by the 0.18 builder). litert-lm 0.17.1 hands the template each history message as a plain string without the reasoning content, so the previous file also passed three turns on it (the same token counts, 76 -> 104 -> 118, in a run of 2026-10-13). A function gate, not a throughput measurement.
